## The problem

<!-- What user problem are you trying to solve? Be specific. "It would be nice if..." is not a problem. "I'm losing 3 hours a week because..." is. -->

## The proposal

<!-- What you think should happen. Keep it at the user-facing level; don't pre-design the implementation unless you have strong opinions. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- What else could solve the same problem? Why is this the best option? -->

## Who benefits

<!-- Is this for solo founders? Small teams? CI users? Be specific — feature requests that benefit a specific persona are much easier to prioritise than "everyone will love this". -->

## Does it touch the doctrine?

<!-- If this changes `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, the `HIGH_RISK` list in `classify.js`, or the behaviour of subagents, call it out. Doctrine changes need explicit Paulo sign-off BEFORE any code is written. -->

- [ ] No, pure tooling / UX / docs change
- [ ] Yes, it touches the doctrine or HIGH_RISK

## Which version?

<!-- Is this for v0.6? v0.7? v1.0? Check ROADMAP.md and pick one, or propose a new version. -->

## Additional context

<!-- Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc. -->

**Before submitting:**

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and the roadmap for a duplicate
